# SuperCodeForge profile

Extend CodeForge evidence with the static source/build/test graph and dependency order.
Every edge must identify its source, direction, revision and evidence level. Keep
dynamic bindings and unavailable GitHub, CI or target-host evidence explicitly open.
Plan ownership and integration order before overlapping writes; changes to another
project require that project's own explicit task and scope.

Lies vor der Arbeit die für den konkreten Auftrag passenden Repository-Skills. Prüfe die Seiteneffekte der verwendeten CLI-Einstiege. Verwende bei einer Analyse nur lesende Aktionen.
